warmup.name: Arm Swings
warmup.cues: Relax shoulders, ribs down, tall spine

warmup.name: Torso Twists
warmup.cues: Rotate through upper back, hips mostly forward

primary.name: Cable Band Chops
primary.cues: Anchor band at high point. Kneel and pull band diagonally down across body. Core must be fully engaged. Rotate from trunk, not arms.
primary.progression: Move further from anchor or double up band if resistance is too light

primary.name: Band Pull-Apart
primary.cues: Ribs down, don't shrug. Arms straight out front, pull band apart.

warmup.name: High Knees
warmup.cues: Drive knee to hip height. Stay tall. Increase speed only if posture stays controlled.

warmup.name: Hip Openers
warmup.cues: Relax shoulders, ribs down, tall spine

warmup.name: Step Back Lunges
warmup.cues: Step back softly. Front heel grounded. Torso tall. Control the return.

warmup.name: Butt Kicks
warmup.cues: Relax shoulders, keep posture tall, try to reach heel to butt

primary.name: Band Lateral Leg Lifts
primary.cues: Make sure you stand straight and not lean to the side. Lift as high as you can while balancing on the other leg.
primary.contraindications: Don't work through unreasonable hip pain.
primary.progression: Don't lift leg as high if it is too difficult.

primary.name: Band Leg Extensions
primary.cues: Smooth. Don't snap the band. Band around ankle, anchor to chair leg, extend knee forward slowly.
primary.progression: Lighter band or smaller range if too hard

primary.name: Plié Squats
primary.cues: Toes out. Knees tracking over toes. Chest up.

warmup.name: Shoulder Blade Squeezes
warmup.cues: Back and down. No shrug. Pause + squeeze back (not up).

warmup.name: Arm Swings
warmup.cues: Relax shoulders, ribs down, tall spine

warmup.name: Lateral Arm Raises
warmup.cues: Stand tall, ribs down. Soft bend in elbows. Lift arms out to the side toward shoulder height. Lower slowly with control.
warmup.progression: Add very light weight only when fully pain-free at shoulder height

primary.name: Band Internal-External Rotation
primary.cues: Use a band with enough resistance to feel the work. Keep elbows and biceps close to sides throughout. Rotate internally then externally with control.
primary.progression: Increase band resistance only when full range is pain-free and controlled

primary.name: DB Tricep Kickbacks
primary.cues: Elbows locked to side. Elbows above body height. Neutral spine — look 45° down.
primary.progression: Stay in deep lunge for additional challenge
